title: Dataset License and Rights Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Reuse conditions, attribution rules, restrictions, and source permissions for datasets. The Dataset License and Rights Database keeps builders on the right side of data law: for each dataset, what the license allows, what attribution it requires, what it forbids, and who granted the permission. Training a model on data you may not use, or publishing without required attribution, creates real liability — this database makes the reuse terms of every dataset explicit, checkable, and attached to the data itself so the terms travel with the bytes.

title: Dataset License and Rights Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. License anatomy: permissions (reproduce, distribute, adapt, commercial use), conditions (attribution, share-alike, notice), prohibitions (no commercial, no derivatives). Common families: public domain (CC0), permissive (MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY), copyleft (GPL, CC-BY-SA), non-commercial (CC-BY-NC), proprietary/custom. Compatibility: permissive + copyleft usually requires copyleft terms on the combination; NC terms never drop by mixing; custom licenses need human review. Attribution: the exact credit line, where it must appear, and what it must link. Provenance: every license record traces to the license text as published by the rights holder, with retrieved_at.

demo.code: function jw(a,b){a=a.toLowerCase();b=b.toLowerCase();if(a===b)return 1;let m=0;const n=Math.min(a.length,b.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]===b[i])m++;return m/Math.max(a.length,b.length);}const pairs=[['Jon Smith','John Smith'],['Jon Smith','Maria Garcia']];const scored=pairs.map(([x,y])=>({x,y,s:+jw(x,y).toFixed(2)}));J({scored});assert(scored[0].s>scored[1].s,'match');

body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: parser test (known licenses parse to known terms); compatibility test (documented compatible/incompatible pairs decide correctly); attribution test (generated lines contain all required elements); determinism test. Limitations: not legal advice — stated on every verdict; custom licenses route to human review; terms change, so verdicts expire with the record's verification date. Every record links the source license text.

demo.title: Execution: pipeline stage hashing and replay
demo.code: const crypto=require('crypto');function h(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex').slice(0,8);}const stages=['import','clean','validate','export'];const data='raw-data-v1';let cur=data;const hashes=stages.map(s=>{cur=s+':'+cur;return s+'='+h(cur);});const replay=(()=>{let c=data;return stages.map(s=>{c=s+':'+c;return s+'='+h(c);});})();J({hashes:hashes.length,replayMatch:JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay)});assert(JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay),'replay');
